skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the characteristics, classification, evaluation criteria of mineral resources, mining methods and processing.
Understand the market dynamics of mineral resources and the role of government in the mineral sector.
Understand key economic issues related to mineral resources, including economic models and cost-benefit analysis.
Understand strategic planning for mineral resource management, including policy formulation and implementation.
Apply critical thinking to analyze economic issues related to mineral resources.
Apply problem-solving skills to identify optimal production levels and timeframes for mineral extraction.
Demonstrate ability to plan, coordinate, manage resources, and improve group work efficiency.
Develop presentation skills, including slide preparation and peer review.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in making judgments and evaluations on specialized issues.
